description: Upload attachments into an attachment cell by URL. Airtable's servers fetch each URL directly (the UI's 'Add attachment → Add URL') — bytes are NOT proxied through this server. Use for multipleAttachments fields, which update_records cannot set. Appends to the cell (calling twice adds two). Per-update isolation: a failing update is reported, not fatal.

debug.description: When true, include raw Airtable response in output for diagnostics

updates.description: Attachments to upload, each { rowId: "recXXX", columnId: "fldXXX", url: "https://...", filename?: "name.jpg" }. filename defaults to the URL path basename.

filename.description: Optional filename override; defaults to the URL path basename

url.description: Public URL of the file to fetch and upload

name: upload_attachment
